Definition: from G3611; a fellow resident, i.e. menial domestic:--(household) servant.
BiblicalUsage: Oiketes is a household servant, a fellow resident of the house. Jesus says in Luke 16:13 that no servant can serve two masters, and in Acts 10:7 Cornelius calls two of his household servants, and a devout soldier, to send to Peter.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the household servant proves that serving has one master, and a man who tries to serve two will love one and despise the other.
